subject.title: refactor: consolidate Knip into a single config

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a single Knip configuration that delegates conventional bundled-plugin entry discovery to Knip’s upstream OpenClaw plugin, or retain repository-owned specialized configurations?
rationale: The author explicitly requested direction before further polishing, and this choice sets the long-term ownership boundary for a CI gate rather than fixing a defined runtime bug.

options.title: Adopt the unified configuration
options.body: Accept the upstream OpenClaw plugin as the discovery contract, contingent on inspectable parity output for both scan modes.

options.title: Keep specialized configurations
options.body: Retain explicit repository-owned entry lists if maintainers prefer audit behavior not to depend on the upstream plugin’s conventions.

recommendation.title: Adopt the unified configuration
recommendation.body: Accept the upstream OpenClaw plugin as the discovery contract, contingent on inspectable parity output for both scan modes.

likelyOwner.reason: webpro has direct domain context for the upstream Knip plugin and submitted the proposed consolidation.
